name: Etched Tablet
summary: Gornek sends a carved tablet to hunters in the Valley of Trials. It bears Jen'shan's mark and calls them to begin training in the wilderness.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: Gornek brings novice hunters a carved tablet after they prove themselves against the boars near the Den. The stone bears Jen'shan's mark. She is a skilled troll huntswoman stationed nearby, and the message shows that seasoned hunters have noticed the young recruit's grit. The lesson now moves beyond surviving the local dangers and toward disciplined training in the wild.

sections.title: The Sharing of Survival
sections.body: Jen'shan teaches that orcs and trolls have a long history within the Horde. Orcs brought renowned traditions of warriors and shamans, while the Darkspear trolls carried ancient skills in stalking, tracking, and survival. Those skills helped the orcs endure life on Azeroth. As Jen'shan trains new hunters, the two peoples continue to share what they know, bound by respect for the hunt.

faq.answer: Jen'shan sends the inscribed stone, and Gornek delivers it after you prove yourself in the Valley of Trials.
Jen'shan is in the northern part of the Valley of Trials in Durotar, among the other class instructors near the Den.

faq.q: Why do troll trainers teach orc hunters here?
faq.answer: Jen'shan says the Horde turned to trolls for hunting lore while struggling to survive on Azeroth. Orcs already knew the ways of warriors and shamans, and the two peoples still share their skills.

faq.q: What happens after turning in this tablet?
faq.answer: Jen'shan accepts you as her student and offers to teach you the basic techniques, shots, and survival practices of Horde hunters as you gain experience.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be finished before getting this tablet?
faq.answer: You must first finish Gornek's initial task, Cutting Teeth, by slaying mottled boars to prove your endurance.

faq.q: Can any class complete this quest?
faq.answer: Only novice hunters can receive this training summons in the Valley of Trials. Other classes receive different summons from Gornek.

angles.text: As a hunter, you receive your first place among Horde hunters and begin learning from your local trainer in the wilderness.
As a troll, you can see how Darkspear hunting lore helped the Horde survive on Kalimdor and support its allies.
As an orc, you learn refined stalking and tracking from your Darkspear allies, adding to your people's warrior traditions.
As a member of the Horde, you see orcs and trolls share their distinct strengths to help both peoples survive.
